content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Charleston

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and documented project-management experience. Review PMI's specific hour requirements for your educational background, then gather evidence of your project work. Granite PM Academy's enrollment team can help you verify you meet the credential's prerequisites before you enroll.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Certification Training course. Attend sessions on your schedule from anywhere, learning core frameworks, best practices, and exam-aligned content from active certified practitioners. You'll earn all required contact hours and receive proof of completion for your PMI application.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing your contact hours, create your PMI account and submit your formal application with your education, work history, and course completion documentation. Pay the PMI exam fee at that time. PMI will review and approve your application, typically within business days, clearing you to schedule your exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Take the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice exams, study guides, and instructor Q&A—to reinforce your knowledge. Schedule your proctored exam through PMI's testing partner. Sit for the computer-based exam at an approved test center, demonstrating mastery of project-management knowledge and scenarios.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: After earning your PMP, commit to the three-year renewal cycle by earning professional development units (PDUs) through training, volunteer work, and professional activities. Track your PDUs and submit your renewal application to PMI before expiration. Staying current keeps your credential active and marketable throughout your career.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI sets four eligibility paths based on education: a secondary diploma (high school or equivalent) requires 60 months of project leadership experience; an associate's degree requires 48 months; a bachelor's degree requires 36 months; and a bachelor's or postgraduate degree from a PMI Global Accreditation Center (GAC)-accredited program requires just 24 months. Every path also requires 35 hours of project management education — our course satisfies this requirement in full.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.
